##### Project General Facts

Rotana Residences Al Reem Island is thoughtfully designed to deliver a modern residential lifestyle shaped by comfort, quality, and contemporary architecture. Inspired by Rotana’s hospitality philosophy, the development blends refined living with a strong sense of community, creating an environment where everyday life feels balanced and welcoming. The concept reflects Rotana’s long-standing commitment to service excellence and meaningful experiences, translating trusted hospitality values into residential living while emphasizing warmth, care, and long-term value.

The residences are planned as a lifestyle-oriented community that encourages connection, relaxation, and wellbeing. Shared spaces are carefully curated to support both active and social routines, offering residents opportunities to unwind, recharge, and spend quality time with family and friends. Amenities include residents’ lounges, reception areas, fitness facilities, outdoor swimming spaces, landscaped gardens, jogging paths, lawn areas, children’s play zones, kids’ pools, barbecue areas, and padel facilities. Together, these features create a seamless balance between leisure, wellness, and everyday convenience, reinforcing the idea of a personal sanctuary supported by attentive hospitality.

Interior spaces are guided by modern design principles that prioritize comfort and functionality while maintaining an elegant aesthetic. Homes feature thoughtfully arranged layouts with refined finishes, allowing for both privacy and open living. Furniture concepts complement the contemporary style, while decorative elements focus on warmth and simplicity to create inviting atmospheres. Kitchens are designed as integrated living spaces, combining practicality with clean, modern lines. Materials and finishes throughout reflect quality and durability, supporting interiors that feel polished, welcoming, and adaptable to personal taste.

##### Location Description and Benefits

Al Reem Island represents a dynamic intersection of modern ambition and natural tranquility. As one of Abu Dhabi’s most forward-looking districts, the island offers an environment where innovation, lifestyle, and waterfront serenity coexist. Its setting allows residents to enjoy expansive coastal views and green surroundings while remaining closely connected to the city’s evolving urban core, creating a balanced atmosphere that supports both productivity and relaxation.

The area benefits from excellent connectivity to key destinations across Abu Dhabi, placing educational institutions, business districts, healthcare services, retail centres, parks, and cultural landmarks within easy reach. This strategic accessibility simplifies daily routines and enhances quality of life, allowing residents to move seamlessly between professional commitments and leisure activities. The surrounding community is vibrant and well established, offering a comprehensive range of services and experiences that contribute to a convenient and well-rounded lifestyle.

In addition, the presence of nearby green spaces and landscaped parklands introduces a sense of openness and calm to everyday living. The island’s thoughtful urban planning encourages outdoor activity, social interaction, and family-friendly living, while its coastal character adds a refreshing dimension to the residential experience. Together, these qualities make Al Reem Island an appealing destination for those seeking a harmonious blend of city energy, natural beauty, and long-term livability.
